architectural-decision-records.why: records the aggregator decision and its alternatives
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0043: one manifest-driven aggregator under a single required check, required blocks / advisory reports, fail-closed, with considered options and the args limit
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the aggregator ships a discrimination test for every exit path
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added run-manifest-gates.mjs and a test that builds fixture repos with passing and failing gates asserting 0 all-pass, 1 required-fail, 0 advisory-only-fail, 2 fail-closed
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven test running real child-process gates is the right level for an orchestrator; no integration/e2e surface beyond that
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; behavior is committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the aggregator's behavior is specified in the merged bootstrap-v2 feature files (genesis enforcement-on, daily-development); this implements the runner they assume, with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the aggregator executes gate scripts whose paths come from a potentially attacker-controlled manifest
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: runs each gate via spawnSync with array args (no shell string, so no command injection) and a path-containment guard that refuses a script path escaping the repo; fails closed rather than running an arbitrary file
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR is explicit about the limit and what is deferred
skeptical-audit.what: stated that gates run with no runtime args yet (a future schema field) and that the provenance gate is a separate ADR/PR
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch review over the aggregator, its test, and the ADR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI orchestrator script; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a straightforward run-and-aggregate loop

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

arch-encode.why: planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
